scope.child_scope: At most one exact frozen15-second normal-owner SQLite child per original episode; subprocess.run owns timeout kill/wait. Outer timeout retains its process group; no --foreground.
scope.cleanup_scope: Saved authenticated receipts only; no fresh lifecycle absence probe.
scope.null_device_exception: Only canonical POSIX character device /dev/null major1/minor3, O_RDWR with optional O_CLOEXEC; no create/truncate/append. Exact subprocess envelope remains enforced.
scope.sqlite_coordination: mode=ro/query_only may create/remove engine-owned WAL/SHM; existing sidecars validated if present
